possible_explanations.statement: The price peak might be associated with the higher dispatch TOTALDEMAND around 2026-07-29 20:05 AEST (UTC+1000) [c.f. totaldemand at that interval ev0722], together with net interconnector flow out of TAS1 at that interval (ev0723).
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check unit-by-unit generation availability and five-minute dispatch schedules for the intervals ending 2026-07-29 20:05 AEST (UTC+1000) and the neighbouring five-minute intervals using generation and dispatch records (for example, call get_generation_change for those intervals) to see whether supply-side availability or offer changes coincide with the peak interval.

possible_explanations.statement: Broader demand patterns in the window might be relevant: the half-hour operational demand reached 1452.0 MW at interval ending 2026-07-29 08:00 AEST (UTC+1000) (a different demand measure, ev0885), which could indicate elevated demand periods in the window.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare the half-hour operational demand at 2026-07-29 08:00 AEST (UTC+1000) (ev0885) with five-minute dispatch TOTALDEMAND and generation/interconnector patterns across the day (use get_actual_demand series and five-minute dispatch TOTALDEMAND intervals) to see temporal alignment of demand peaks and five‑minute price movements.
